_doc: Trophy Hype opportunity library — hand-curated starter set spanning both arenas. Real events, orgs, and coarse coordinates; windows use 2026 dates or rolling. The daily heartbeat (scripts/trophy-heartbeat.mjs) expands this by discovery and scores each by fit. verifyBy lists the proof methods a result here can support — it sets the ceiling on how strongly a trophy from it can be proven.

opportunities.description: One of the largest timed 10Ks in the world, finishing in Folsom Field.
